evidence_items.explanation: This provides a pre-existing basis for concern about finite high-quality language data. It is a conditional projection about existing data stocks, not proof that suitable new data cannot be created.

The paper describes training a small code model with web data and synthetically generated material. This challenges a blanket dismissal of synthetic data, but does not establish sufficient data for continued frontier-model scaling.

Klarna publicly offered a positive indication of possible profits outside Nvidia before the post. The figure was a forecast, so it cannot establish realized profit or by itself refute the qualified word 'little'.

metric_scope.metric: Projected profit improvement attributable to its AI assistant

unresolved_gaps: No defined frontier-training requirement makes 'enough data' measurable.
The verified synthetic-data demonstration does not establish frontier-scale sufficiency.
No sufficiently comprehensive, comparable record of attributable generative-AI profits was established for the publication-time assessment.
The financial claim supplies no accounting basis; this prevents a supported or contradicted money assessment.
